transcript: I'm trying to figure out why I liked this musical as much as I did and you might say it's obvious like what's not to like? the show is charming it's earnest it has a likeable cast of characters and it touches on some important themes and yeah all of that is true but the same could be said for a bunch of other shows that didn't work for me nearly as well as this one real women have curves is a new musical based on the film of the same name and the play that inspired the original film it follows the women in a Mexican American family as they navigate internal tensions and external challenges particularly the looming threat of increased ice raids In some ways the show feels very groundbreaking in the sense that it's depicting a culture and a set of social issues that are very rarely represented in musical theatre but in other ways you know it's not without its cliches and stylistically the show for the most part feels pretty conventional maybe that's by design you know like a statement saying “hey, our stories belong in the traditional canon of musical theatre!” and I think that is totally valid but it can be really tough to pull off this brand of like earnest feel-good charm without crossing over into feeling kind of trite and cloying but I think real women have curves pulls it off I had a big grin on my face throughout the entire show so why did it succeed where other shows kind of like this failed? I think at least some part of it is just alchemy it just the specific ways that all of the pieces come together in the creative process and getting on the right wavelength with the audience but I could also point to some more concrete things like the writing is very funny the chemistry between the characters is extremely strong and everything about it just feels very organic even when it comes to like the social justice messaging of the show it's urgent and overt and unmistakable but it's not preachy or simplistic and it feels totally integrated into the storytelling there's a pretty wide range of people that I would recommend this show to and to those people I would recommend seeing it sooner rather than later because the show is unfortunately struggling at the box office right now but the people who are seeing it are really enjoying it so it seems to be just a question of getting the word out there
